title: Feature module architecture and guard v2
intent: Create a typed module registry, strict import guard and auth feature boundary after the kernel debt handoff.

requirements.title: Module kernel and auth boundary
requirements.description: Register feature modules, detect collisions and forbidden runtime imports, and move auth behavior behind owned ports and pages.

constraints: Stage 2 debt handoff is a prerequisite.
Guard debt map is owned only by this stage.
No legacy page deletion or backend code.
